findingsFromThePilot.what: renderPublicSafety read its regions IN SERIES, so the last region on a lens painted three round trips late. On the Police lens the late one is the Patrol roster - the single region this row exists to make visible - and it sat reading 'Not read' beside a fully populated Camera inventory.
findingsFromThePilot.why it matters: a failure state dressed as a loading state, on the one region that proves ruling 1.
findingsFromThePilot.howFound: the rendered walk's first pass read the roster as unrendered; the diagnosis was the loop order, not the markup.
findingsFromThePilot.fix: the three regions are read concurrently and rendered after. Comment in web/app.js records the incident rather than just the change.

findingsFromThePilot.severity: instrument defect in this lane's own walk, fixed
findingsFromThePilot.what: the walk waited on the FIRST region's caption only, so it read the DOM before the rest of the lens had painted and would have reported a green surface with an unrendered roster.
findingsFromThePilot.why it matters: it is the same shape as R2-F1 one layer up: an instrument that stops measuring before the thing it measures has happened. It nearly certified the defect it was built to catch.
findingsFromThePilot.fix: the walk waits for EVERY region on the lens.

findingsFromThePilot.what: web/index.html loads a render-blocking Google Fonts stylesheet, and a module script cannot execute until that resolves. On this machine that link was taking tens of seconds, which timed out three consecutive walks and looked exactly like a product hang - the first two diagnoses were both wrong.
findingsFromThePilot.measured: with the third-party stylesheet answered by an empty 200, first paint to committed navigation is 29 to 91 ms; without it, page.goto exceeded 30 s.
findingsFromThePilot.carriedForward: the walk intercepts THIRD-PARTY ONLY, by URL predicate. A catch-all route that merely continues local requests stalls them, which produced two more false negatives before it was measured. Not a product change: the font link is pre-existing and belongs to nobody on this wave, but a lane that reads 'the product hangs' from it would be wrong, so it is recorded.

findingsFromThePilot.severity: gate interaction, fixed in this lane
findingsFromThePilot.what: three product gates fired on this lane's own PROSE rather than on its behaviour: `typeof kind.id === "string"` read as an element-id comparison to the addressability gate and required an id named 'string'; the words 'no rgb()' inside a CSS comment tripped the no-colour-function rule; and a comment in domain-render.mjs quoting the three forbidden freshness strings tripped the freshness rule.
findingsFromThePilot.reading: all three are DEV_PROCESS 2.6 - a source file parsed by a tool has a character set, and these gates read comments. Every one is the gate working. Recorded because the next rendering lane will hit at least one of them.
